a: Ẹ káàárọ̀ means good morning in Yoruba.
Ẹ káàsán means good afternoon in Yoruba.
Ẹ káalẹ́ means good evening in Yoruba.
Ina kwana means good morning in Hausa.
Ina wuni means good afternoon/day in Hausa.
Ị bọọla chi means good morning in Igbo.
Kedu ka ị mere? means how are you in Igbo.
Báwo ni? means how are you in Yoruba.
Yaya kake/kike? means how are you in Hausa.
How you dey? means how are you in Pidgin.
